items.title: 2027 Better Together Puzzle Characters
items.alt: Four smiling red, yellow, blue and green jigsaw characters form 2027 above a Better Together ribbon.
items.description: White gloves, colorful sneakers and different expressions give each connected puzzle piece a separate personality.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Origami Crane Greeting
items.alt: Three patterned paper cranes fly above Welcome 2027 lettering decorated with small pink blossoms and flowing ribbons.
items.description: Ivory, teal and coral folded birds echo the year’s floral pattern and gold borders in an asymmetrical greeting composition.

items.title: Up and Away 2027 Patchwork Balloon
items.alt: A colorful patchwork hot-air balloon displays Up and Away above 2027, with a complete wicker basket suspended below.
items.description: Striped, dotted and checked fabric panels surround the cream central label, while gold ropes connect the envelope to the basket.

items.title: Class of 2027 Graduation Bouquet
items.alt: Ivory magnolias, blue irises and eucalyptus wrapped in cream paper, tied with a navy bow and a Class of 2027 tag.
items.description: The tall flower arrangement rises above the large hanging cream label, with the stem ends kept visible below.

items.title: December 2027 Evergreen Lettering
items.alt: Green December lettering and red 2027 numerals sit beneath an evergreen branch with a red bow and gold ornament.
items.description: Gold borders and delicate snowflake patterns decorate the raised year, with red berries tucked among the pine needles.

items.title: Emerald Crystal 2027
items.alt: Wide 2027 numerals formed from faceted emerald-green crystal with clear beveled edges.
items.description: Triangular reflections run through the low geometric digits, with a full open center in the zero.
